source: day 2, 05:32-06:02Z: three review requests delegated in one batch. One was approved and recorded; one was skipped (already approved) but the skip was only said in the window; one session was interrupted and recorded nothing. The orchestrator read two windows' screens to find out.
setup: bosun ledger upsert 'review:acme/exporter#105' --kind review-request --field requester='Priya Nair'
bosun ledger upsert 'review:acme/exporter#106' --kind review-request --field requester='Lena Ortiz'
bosun ledger upsert 'review:acme/billing-api#112' --kind review-request --field requester='Priya Nair'

steps.why: the real batch: transition to delegated, then delegate --window
out: Run this task in a subagent

steps.run: bosun ledger report 'review:acme/exporter#105' --state reviewed --summary 'APPROVE; two optional nits inline' --result 'https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/105#pullrequestreview-1' --field reviewed_at=2026-03-13T05:39:50Z --field reviewed_sha=0000001abc

steps.why: the skip, now recorded instead of only said in the window
steps.run: bosun ledger report 'review:acme/billing-api#112' --state dismissed --summary 'already approved by ksato-acme; no specific ask; nothing posted'

steps.why: the interrupted one stands out without reading a screen
reports since the last run include the item the report closed
out: summary: APPROVE; two optional nits inline

steps.why: asks the silent window for a report, by id
steps.run: bosun delegate --update 'review:acme/exporter#106' --details 'Report where this review stands with bosun ledger report (skip it if someone else already approved).'

steps.why: the real decision once GitHub showed two approvals
steps.run: bosun ledger transition review:acme/exporter#106 dismissed --note 'already approved by pnair-acme and ksato-acme; no review from me'

steps.why: a finished item takes no more updates
out: is dismissed; a finished item takes no updates
